author: Cinna Davis with OpenAI Codex assistance
statement: For a supplied tree, exact syndrome states attain every cut-rank bound. Every exact field-valued tree realization of a binary [m,k,D] code indicator with k>0 has maximum Boolean-port degree at least ceil(k/floor(m/D)); applied conditionally to the accepted sparse-check interface. No SAT time gain.
